label: Weather: Open-Meteo
info:
Fetches weather from Open-Meteo (MeteoSwiss ICON model) and publishes to MQTT.

Setup:
1. Set env WEATHER_LOCATION to city name (e.g. 'Zürich') or set WEATHER_LAT / WEATHER_LON directly
2. Set env WEATHER_PANELS to comma-separated panel IDs (e.g. 'kitchen,wohnzimmer')
3. Nominatim geocoding runs on startup to resolve city → lat/lon
4. Weather is fetched every 10 minutes

name: fn_geo_check
fn_geo_extract
func:
const results = msg.payload
if (!Array.isArray(results) || results.length === 0) {
    node.error('Nominatim geocoding failed: no results for ' + flow.get('weather_location'))
    return null
}
const r = results[0]
flow.set('weather_lat', parseFloat(r.lat))
flow.set('weather_lon', parseFloat(r.lon))
// Use only first part of display_name as location label
flow.set('weather_location', r.display_name.split(',')[0].trim())
node.log('Geocoded to ' + r.lat + ',' + r.lon + ' (' + flow.get('weather_location') + ')')
return msg

name: fn_openmeteo_url
func:
const lat = flow.get('weather_lat')
const lon = flow.get('weather_lon')
if (!lat || !lon) {
    node.warn('No coordinates available yet — retrying in next cycle')
    return null
}
const params = [
    'latitude=' + lat,
    'longitude=' + lon,
    'current=temperature_2m,apparent_temperature,relative_humidity_2m,precipitation,weather_code,wind_speed_10m,wind_direction_10m',
    'hourly=temperature_2m,precipitation_probability,weather_code',
    'daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_sum,sunrise,sunset',
    'timezone=auto',
    'forecast_days=7',
    'models=icon_seamless',
    'wind_speed_unit=kmh'
].join('&')
msg.url = 'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?' + params
return msg

name: fn_weather_transform
func:
const d = msg.payload
if (!d || !d.current || msg.statusCode !== 200) {
    node.error('Open-Meteo error: ' + JSON.stringify(d))
    return null
}

// Find start index in hourly data (current hour)
const nowIso = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 13)  // 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH'
const times = d.hourly?.time ?? []
const startIdx = times.findIndex(t => t >= nowIso)
const s = startIdx >= 0 ? startIdx : 0

const hourly = times.slice(s, s + 24).map((t, i) => ({
    time: t,
    temp: d.hourly.temperature_2m[s + i],
    code: d.hourly.weather_code[s + i],
    precip_prob: d.hourly.precipitation_probability?.[s + i] ?? 0
}))

const daily = (d.daily?.time ?? []).map((date, i) => ({
    date,
    code: d.daily.weather_code[i],
    temp_max: d.daily.temperature_2m_max[i],
    temp_min: d.daily.temperature_2m_min[i],
    precip_sum: Math.round((d.daily.precipitation_sum[i] ?? 0) * 10) / 10,
    sunrise: (d.daily.sunrise?.[i] ?? '').slice(11, 16),
    sunset:  (d.daily.sunset?.[i]  ?? '').slice(11, 16)
}))

msg.weatherPayload = {
    location: flow.get('weather_location') || 'Unbekannt',
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    current: {
        temperature: d.current.temperature_2m,
        apparent_temperature: d.current.apparent_temperature,
        relative_humidity: d.current.relative_humidity_2m,
        precipitation: d.current.precipitation,
        weather_code: d.current.weather_code,
        wind_speed: d.current.wind_speed_10m,
        wind_direction: d.current.wind_direction_10m
    },
    hourly,
    daily
}

// Build list of panels from env (comma-separated) or default to 'kitchen'
const panelsEnv = env.get('WEATHER_PANELS') || 'kitchen'
msg.panels = panelsEnv.split(',').map(p => p.trim()).filter(Boolean)
msg.panelIndex = 0
return msg

name: fn_weather_publish_loop
func:
const panels = msg.panels
const i = msg.panelIndex
if (i >= panels.length) return null

const panelId = panels[i]
msg.topic = 'dashboard/panels/' + panelId + '/weather/state'
msg.payload = msg.weatherPayload
msg.retain = true
msg.qos = 1
msg.panelIndex = i + 1

if (i + 1 < panels.length) {
    node.send([msg, msg])  // port 1: mqtt out, port 2: loop back
} else {
    node.send([msg, null])  // last panel, no loop
}
return
